metadata.evidence_note: Authored single-file utility with an executable defect. Not an upstream historical commit and not a model-capability result.

prompt: Edit range_sums.py so range_sums still returns exact integer sums for every valid query, and so repeated queries over a long value list do less work than scanning each interval from scratch. test_public.py is a smoke check and is not the grader. Do not special-case one input list.
title: Keep exact range sums and reduce their asymptotic work
